stock.noAccess: Your role does not see stock: what lies in each place is not shown.
stock.tryInside: Turn on “Include the places inside” to see what lies below it.

held.noManage: Your role sees places but does not change them.
held.archived: Archived: it takes no more stock and does not move.
held.hides_one: Holds {count} hide: move it out first.
held.hides_other: Holds {count} hides: move them out first.
held.stock_one: Holds {count} stock line: move it out first.
held.stock_other: Holds {count} stock lines: move them out first.
held.inside_one: {count} active place sits inside: archive or move it first.
held.inside_other: {count} active places sit inside: archive or move them first.

new.title: New location
new.parentHint: The place it sits inside: a bin in a zone, a zone in a warehouse.
new.codeHint: Printed on the bin label and scanned: capitals, digits, dots and dashes. It never changes.
new.codeShape: Use 1 to 40 capitals, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
new.codeTaken: This site already has a place with this code.

move.title: Move {code} under…
move.hint: Only places that are not this one or inside it.
move.stockStays: Its stock stays where it is: only the tree changes.

archive.title: Archive {code}?
archive.effect: An archived place takes no more stock and nothing can be put inside it.
archive.history: Its moves and its code stay in the history; the code is never given to another place.

done.archived: {code} archived: it takes no more stock.

problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed this place meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.notNow: Not now: the place holds stock or active places inside, or it is archived.
problem.parent: That place cannot hold it: it is archived, or it is this place or one inside it.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not change places at this site.
problem.gone: This place no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Try again.

empty.title: No locations yet
empty.body: Add the warehouses, zones and bins of this site, or import them from a sheet.
empty.bodyView: Nobody has added the places of this site yet.

noSites.title: No site to show
noSites.body: Your role reaches no site of this company.

record.title: {kind} {code} · {name}
record.notFound: This location does not exist or is in another company
record.notFoundBody: Go back to the list of places.
record.archivedBody: It takes no more stock; its history and code stay. Its fields are shown as text.
record.codeFixed: Printed bin labels show this code; it never changes.
record.nothingInside: No place sits inside this one.
record.newInsideHint: Add a place inside it from the list’s row menu.
record.isArchived: Archived: it takes no more stock.
record.archiveFree: Empty, with nothing active inside: it may be archived (⋯ Archive).

conflict.title: Changed by someone else meanwhile
conflict.body: Your typing is still here. Reload reads the place again and replaces it.
